reserves.name: RIF and DOC collateral in RIF On Chain V3 buckets

sources.label: RIF On Chain V3 multi-collateral announcement

reserveReview.rationale: RIF On Chain's May 2026 V3 announcement states that RIF and DOC each have a collateral bucket and both contribute to one fungible USDRIF supply. The protocol documentation confirms the RIF bucket's collateralized USDRIF model. Neither source publishes a current value or percentage for either bucket, so the reserve composition cannot be split into RIF and DOC slices.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current RIF and DOC collateral values and weights are not publicly disclosed in the reviewed sources.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: RIF and DOC collateral in RIF On Chain V3 buckets
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The two collateral buckets are verified, but no dated public allocation supports a percentage split.
